snippet.title: Murmuring of Moth Mouth - VAINSANE Fridays #10 #visualnovel #psychologicalhorror
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #10 — Murmuring of Moth Mouth


An eleven-year-old video shows Yuna's car on the road today. Its instructions promise to get her to the interview that could change her life... A short psychological horror visual novel about desperation and dependence.

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Released October 2nd, 2026.

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5075730/Murmuring_of_Moth_Mouth/
